name: @bramgeron/pi-set-thinking
description: Pi extension for cycling the active thinking level backward
author: Bram Geron

scripts.smoke: rm -rf .tmp/smoke && mkdir -p .tmp/smoke && pnpm pack --pack-destination .tmp/smoke >/dev/null && tar -xzf "$(find .tmp/smoke -maxdepth 1 -name '*.tgz' -print -quit)" -C .tmp/smoke && printf '{"id":"smoke","type":"get_commands"}\n' | pi --no-extensions --no-session --offline -e .tmp/smoke/package --mode rpc | grep -q '"success":true'
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke
